title: Iterated beta integrals
summary: We introduce iterated beta integrals, a new class of iterated integrals on the universal abelian covering of the punctured projective line that unifies hyperlogarithms and classical beta integrals while preserving their fundamental properties. We establish various analytic properties of these integrals with respect to both the exponent parameters and the main variables. Their key feature is invariance under simultaneous translation of the exponent parameters, which generates relations between integrals over possibly different coverings.
